narr: A stronger storm system impacted Southern California on New Year's Eve with heavier precipitation and higher winds. Multiple reports of flooding and high winds were received on New Year's Eve alone. Heavy precipitation and wind continued into January 1st with impacts detailed in a different episode.
ev: Orange County Fire Authority reported 2 vehicles stuck in water on the 4th Street off-ramp on SR-55 Northbound. Occupants were stuck inside and on top of their vehicles and required rescuing. Rainfall totals generally between 1.10 and 1.75 inch occurred in this area on New Year's Eve.
